value.rationale: The exact least integer phase resolution that improves the classical seven-chip Barker waveform is a motivated design invariant: q2–q6 do not beat energy 3, q7 beats it sharply at 19−26 cos(2π/7). Complete optimizer counts supply reproducible design benchmarks, beyond a numerical search. The theorem does not claim broader or asymptotic optimality.
